notes.text: Alder: The Alder studio bisque firing reaches 950 degrees Celsius.
Alder: Our selected operating rule is: Members clean wheel splash pans before leaving.
Alder: For the autumn glaze workshop, Iris lists a 12-person limit.
Alder: For the same autumn glaze workshop, Pavel lists a 16-person limit; neither list supersedes the other.
Alder: Until 30 June 2026, the studio manager was Tala.
Alder: Effective 1 July 2026, Ren replaced Tala as studio manager.
Wren: The Wren rowing crew stores oars on rack D.
Wren: Our selected operating rule is: Its warm-up circuit is two laps of the inlet.
Wren: Nia says the regatta launch time is 08:20.
Wren: Eli says the same regatta launch time is 08:50; no authoritative schedule is supplied.
Wren: Through 14 March 2026, the crew captain was Oren.
Wren: From 15 March 2026 onward, Liv is the crew captain.
Hearth: The Hearth collective's standard loaf uses 70 percent hydration.
Hearth: Our selected operating rule is: Its shared recipe rests the dough for 40 minutes before kneading.
Hearth: An undated recipe card gives the oven setting as 220 Celsius.
Hearth: Another undated card for the same loaf gives 235 Celsius; neither is designated current.
Hearth: Before 1 September 2026, flour purchases were coordinated by Bo.
Hearth: From 1 September 2026, Anu coordinates flour purchases.
Lantern: The Lantern theatre keeps reusable props in cage 2.
Lantern: Our selected operating rule is: For its school matinee, the interval lasts 15 minutes.
Lantern: A cast sheet names Zuri as narrator for the winter production.
Lantern: A separate current cast sheet names Finn as narrator for that production; neither resolves the discrepancy.
Lantern: During January 2026, stage calls were made by Dev.
Lantern: Beginning 1 February 2026, Mel took responsibility for stage calls.
Hazel: The Hazel apiary marks queen ages with a coloured dot.
Hazel: Our selected operating rule is: The demonstration hive contains eight frames.
Hazel: One inspection note records the demonstration hive as queenright.
Hazel: A second note from the same inspection date records it as queenless; no later verification is available.
Hazel: In spring 2026, apiary visits were booked with Gita.
Hazel: From 1 July 2026, visits are booked with Tomas instead.
Moss: The Moss observatory uses a 25 mm eyepiece for public introductions.
Moss: Our selected operating rule is: Visitors sign in at the lower gate.
Moss: One public-night sheet says observation starts at 20:00.
Moss: Another sheet for the identical public night says 20:30; no revision relationship is recorded.
Moss: Before 10 August 2026, the night coordinator was Pia.
Moss: On 10 August 2026, Sol became night coordinator.
Saffron: The Saffron anthology prints original poems on left-hand pages.
Saffron: Our selected operating rule is: Translator biographies are limited to 60 words.
Saffron: The rights ledger says the poem Stone Window is cleared for print only.
Saffron: A letter covering that same poem says print and audio rights are cleared; its authority relative to the ledger is unknown.
Saffron: Through May 2026, copy-editing queries went to Hana.
Saffron: From 1 June 2026, copy-editing queries go to Miro.
Clover: The Clover quilt backing extends 10 cm beyond every edge.
Clover: Our selected operating rule is: Each patchwork block uses a 6 mm seam allowance.
Clover: The cutting sheet calls for 24 star blocks.
Clover: The assembly sheet calls for 28 star blocks for the same quilt; neither is marked revised.
Clover: During February 2026, the fabric custodian was Wen.
Clover: From 1 March 2026, the fabric custodian is Asha.
Dune: The Dune bird survey begins at marker 7.
Dune: Our selected operating rule is: Observers record wind direction before counting birds.
Dune: One report counts 18 redshanks on the north pool.
Dune: A second report for the same count period gives 23 redshanks; the discrepancy is unresolved.
Dune: Up to 31 July 2026, the survey recorder was Joelle.
Dune: Since 1 August 2026, the survey recorder is Kit.
Fennel: The Fennel radio drama exports audio at 48 kHz.
Fennel: Our selected operating rule is: Its rehearsal script numbers every fifth line.
Fennel: The production board allocates 26 minutes to the episode.
Fennel: The editor's sheet allocates 29 minutes to the same episode, with no final version identified.
Fennel: Until 5 May 2026, sound cues were managed by Esme.
Fennel: From 6 May 2026, sound cues are managed by Ari.
Acorn: The Acorn seed library stores bean packets in drawer F.
Acorn: Our selected operating rule is: Returned seed labels include harvest year.
Acorn: A stock card reports 80 lettuce packets.
Acorn: A same-day audit reports 68 lettuce packets; no reconciliation has been entered.
Acorn: Through 20 April 2026, seed exchanges were hosted by Ivo.
Acorn: From 21 April 2026, seed exchanges are hosted by Rani.
Ripple: The Ripple dance class uses a three-count introduction.
Ripple: Our selected operating rule is: Participants leave outdoor shoes on the entrance shelf.
Ripple: One class announcement names Room Cedar.
Ripple: Another announcement for the same class names Room Elm; neither cancels the other.
Ripple: In January 2026, the accompanist was Bea.
Ripple: From 1 February 2026, the accompanist is Imani.
Reed: The Reed archive requires pencil for reader notes.
Reed: Our selected operating rule is: Map requests use a yellow slip.
Reed: One catalogue entry dates box R4 to 1910.
Reed: A second entry for the same box dates it to 1914; no correction note is present.
Reed: Until 30 September 2026, the reading-room lead was Jan.
Reed: From 1 October 2026, the reading-room lead is Oona.
Brook: The Brook kayaking course uses the sheltered inlet for capsize drills.
Brook: Our selected operating rule is: Participants bring a dry change of clothes.
Brook: A course leaflet gives a minimum age of twelve.
Brook: A booking page for the same course gives a minimum age of fourteen; no governing policy is identified.
Brook: Before 1 June 2026, the course contact was Suki.
Brook: From 1 June 2026, the contact is Emil.
Fern: The Fern sampler uses two strands of floss.
Fern: Our selected operating rule is: The border stitch is running stitch.
Fern: One pattern annotation specifies a 14-count fabric.
Fern: A second annotation on the same pattern specifies 16-count fabric; neither is authoritative.
Fern: Through 31 March 2026, kit packing was led by Ida.
Fern: From 1 April 2026, kit packing is led by Nabil.
Willow: The Willow choir's warm-up starts on a humming exercise.
Willow: Our selected operating rule is: Borrowed scores are returned to tray B.
Willow: One concert plan names an oboe soloist.
Willow: Another plan for that concert names a clarinet soloist; no final plan is marked.
Willow: Until 12 July 2026, attendance was recorded by Tia.
Willow: From 13 July 2026, attendance is recorded by Yun.
Rowan: The Rowan workshop uses water-based relief ink.
Rowan: Our selected operating rule is: Finished prints dry on the upper rack.
Rowan: One edition ledger lists 40 numbered prints.
Rowan: A second ledger for that edition lists 45; neither is marked superseded.
Rowan: During the first quarter of 2026, press bookings went to Luz.
Rowan: From 1 April 2026, press bookings go to Farah.
Birch: The Birch conversation circle begins with paired greetings.
Birch: Our selected operating rule is: Its vocabulary cards show stress marks.
Birch: A facilitator note sets a ten-minute storytelling turn.
Birch: A second note for the same session sets a seven-minute turn; no selection is recorded.
Birch: Before 9 September 2026, the host was Malik.
Birch: From 9 September 2026, the host is Cora.
Juniper: The Juniper layout's station platform is 90 cm long.
Juniper: Our selected operating rule is: Its freight siding is labelled Loop C.
Juniper: One wiring diagram assigns red to the common return.
Juniper: A second diagram for the same wiring assigns black to the common return; no tested revision is identified.
Juniper: Until 31 May 2026, the layout custodian was Lian.
Juniper: From 1 June 2026, the custodian is Petra.
Olive: The Olive kitchen portions soup with a 250 ml ladle.
Olive: Our selected operating rule is: Reusable containers are stacked by the north sink.
Olive: One rota lists four servers for Friday lunch.
Olive: Another rota for that lunch lists six servers; no final rota is available.
Olive: Through 15 February 2026, pantry coordination belonged to Hanae.
Olive: From 16 February 2026, pantry coordination belongs to Luca.
